title: Additive files and dates revision
description: Composed onto bao.workflow/v2. Does not replace that file. Workflow version becomes 3 when this revision is present. Version 2 documents still load.

format.description: Recorded display format. Tokens YYYY YY MMMM MMM MM M DD D.

relative.description: today, +14d, -2d, next monday, or first of next month.

zone.description: IANA zone used to resolve the relative value. Absent uses the run zone.

fromOutput.description: File input satisfied by a previous download output.

download.description: Save the download triggered by this step. name is a filename template, not a path. Benchmark: Power Automate renames after the fact, UiPath Wait for Download returns a path, Playwright saveAs uses the suggested name. Bao waits on CDP Browser.downloadWillBegin and writes the template.

open.description: Open a URL in the browser, or a file. macOS uses open -a <app> <file>. Linux tests use xdg-open and record needs Mac test when an app is named.

datePicker.description: Replay clicks or drags the cell for the resolved date. The recorded day-cell clicks are not replayed.

fileOutput.description: Run output of a download step. Not stored in the workflow.
